name: Praxis (repository operating system; legacy name ROS)
verified_purpose: F#/.NET CLI installed into repositories: work protocol (begin/block/resume/complete), canonical research/decision records with IDs and front matter, generated registries, execution telemetry, agent/human/automation provenance, verified completion via Dokimos, ECIR approval verification, autonomous-merge policy evaluator.
maturity_observed: Mature codebase (414 src .fs files, 196 test files; CI praxis-validation.yml). Many assurance features shipped but opt-in; no examined consumer repo enables requireVerifiedCompletion and consumer pins range rosVersion 1.0.0-3.7.1 (attested completion is post-3.17).
assurance_capabilities_verified: Self-reported actor provenance on executions/events/front matter (refuses re-attribution); append-only JSONL event logs by convention; content-derived eventId checked by validate; DSSE ECDSA-P256 verifier-signed receipts with pinned trust root on protected branch (attested completion, tested: AttestedCompletionTests 54 cases); signed scoped ECIR approval receipts (24h max, host allow-list); owner-signed run authorization + fail-closed merge evaluator with SHA-pinned merges and hash-chained merge receipts; validation of IDs/refs/supersession/stale registries; Sigstore build provenance on native releases.
assurance_gaps: Identity is self-reported, not authenticated (docs/agent-provenance.md). Event logs are not signed or hash-chained (only autonomy merge receipts chain). Attested completion not enabled anywhere observed. Merge gate is advisory unless GitHub rulesets make it mandatory; mandatory enforcement not evidenced (Praxis own diagnosis dated 2026-10-28 describes the gate as self-governance pending owner decision D-2). Platform attribution of agent merges may not distinguish agent from owner (SECURITY-REVIEW R-6). No auditor export package; Folio reports conditional.
evidence_produced: Execution records (.ros/telemetry/executions/EXE-*.json); events.jsonl; front-matter provenance.contributions; claim/completion records with attestation label and verifierKeyIds; merge receipts (praxis.merge-receipt/1, chained); ECIR policy audit (policy.json revision-linked); validation output JSON.
trust_boundary: Runs as the same OS user/agent it records; trust anchors (verifier key, owner key, ECIR allow-list) must live outside agent-writable paths; protected source = merge-base of origin/HEAD read from local refs (agent-rewritable).

name: Dokimos (evidence-based code-quality measurement)
verified_purpose: F# CLI + reusable GitHub Action (actions/quality-gate) that snapshots a revision, compares to an accepted baseline in a durable evidence store (git branch dokimos-evidence), evaluates policy and fails the job; also independently verifies Praxis completion claims (completion verify), including attested mode checking DSSE verifier signatures.
maturity_observed: Operational CLI (EEF audit: v0.11.1; Praxis CI pins 0.7.0). 96 src / 80 test .fs files. Quality-gate action used by Dokimos, Aegis, Fides workflows; not seen in other assessed repos.
assurance_capabilities_verified: Gate fails CI job on evaluation exit code (enforce default true); pinned release install with SHA-256 check; immutable content-addressed snapshots and baseline acceptances with reason; evidence bound to commit SHA; completion verify: authority-bound, fail-closed on missing/extra evidence, replay protection via consumed packet digests, freshness windows, ECDSA-P256 DSSE attestation verification (tests: CompletionAttestationTests, CompletionVerificationTests, QualityGateProofTests); Sigstore attest-build-provenance on release.
assurance_gaps: Whether a failing gate blocks merge depends on GitHub required checks (not evidenced). Evidence store is a git branch: immutability is by convention and detection (exit 5 identity conflict), not WORM; branch rewrite by repo writers not prevented in-repo. Measures code quality, not security. Baseline acceptance is a workflow_dispatch input; approver independence not enforced.
evidence_produced: Snapshots (schema 2.0.0), baseline acceptance records, evaluation disposition/exit code, uploaded artifacts per run, completion-verification receipts (dokimos-completion-verification.schema.json).
trust_boundary: Runs in CI under repository GITHUB_TOKEN with contents: write (to persist evidence); trusts host-supplied authority file; private verifier key held by host, never by agent.
verification_basis: dokimos/README.md; dokimos/actions/quality-gate/action.yml; dokimos/.github/workflows/ci.yml; dokimos/docs/completion-verification.md; dokimos/docs/operations/INTEGRATION.md; dokimos/src/Dokimos.Core/CompletionWire.fs; dokimos/tests/Dokimos.Core.Tests (file list); ref/aegis/.github/workflows/dokimos.yml; ref/fides/.github/workflows/dokimos.yml

name: Ordo (State-Directed Engineering, SDE; CLI alias sde)
verified_purpose: Methodology (doctrine/, method/) plus F# libraries/CLI defining legal state transitions, typed execution roles and capabilities, actor-kind authorization, expected vs observed receipts, decision gate that cannot authorize without passing Transition.evaluate; ECIR validation (executionAuthorized:false always).
maturity_observed: Methodology accepted (SDE-DOCTRINE-002 v0.2.1); 103 src / 80 test .fs files; distributed native + npm. Used by Praxis as pinned validator; library-level, not a runtime service.
assurance_capabilities_verified: Role authority matrix with explicit prohibitions (Implementation cannot RecordVerdict/AcceptReview; Verification/Review cannot ModifyImplementation; no role holds ModifyAcceptanceCriteria/ModifyEvaluationAuthority by default; widening needs named policy decision; widening into prohibition refused) - a segregation-of-duties model; narrative claims excluded from receipt comparison; Indeterminate distinct from success.
assurance_gaps: SoD is a typed model; enforcement depends on a host binding authenticated identities to roles (Ordo actor is supplied by caller). No signing, storage or log of its own. Not verified whether any repository enforces role separation at runtime.
evidence_produced: ordo.resolution-observation records, ECIR validation responses with canonical SHA-256 digests, receipt comparisons (Match/Mismatch/Indeterminate).
trust_boundary: Pure library/CLI invoked by Praxis/Dokimos; authority rests with whatever host supplies actor and policy.
verification_basis: ordo/README.md; ordo/doctrine/STATE-DIRECTED-ENGINEERING.md; ordo/src/Ordo.Core/ExecutionRole.fs; ordo/src/Ordo.Core/Authorization.fs; ordo/src/Ordo.Core/Receipt.fs; ordo/src/Ordo.Decisions/Gate.fs; ordo/tests/Ordo.Tests/ExecutionGovernanceTests.fs (presence); praxis/docs/ordo-observation.md; praxis/docs/ecir-execution.md

name: Limen (browser-kernel boundary library + lifecycle CLI)
verified_purpose: Dependency-free TypeScript library separating browser capabilities (kernel) from application authority (engine) over serializable messages; routing/URL-state module; lifecycle CLI (init/verify --strict) installed as limen-verify.yml.
maturity_observed: Operational npm 0.9.1 with F# packages; 349 TS/JS files; extensive node tests incl. binding-security; Sigstore attest-build-provenance in publish.yml.
assurance_capabilities_verified: Binding security policy (URL/attribute classification; CSP + Trusted Types smoke test), URL-secret parameter refusal (LCP-109), boundary rules tests; supply-chain provenance on publish.
assurance_gaps: Client-side library: no logging, identity or evidence functions; application authority remains in the engine owned by each app.
evidence_produced: limen verify output in CI; release provenance attestations.
trust_boundary: Runs in end-user browser; trust boundary is the kernel/engine message protocol.
